summary: Allows printing multiple certificates, such as ID cards and Admit Cards, for several selected students simultaneously.
steps: Select multiple students from the list for whom certificates need to be printed.
Choose the specific certificate type for bulk printing (e.g., ID Card, Admit Card).
The system will generate and print the selected certificates for all chosen students.
business_rules: Only specific certificate types, such as ID Cards and Admit Cards, are supported for bulk printing.
important_notes: This feature is efficient for generating a large number of certificates at once.
Ensure the correct students are selected before initiating a bulk print job.
questions: Can I print ID cards for multiple students at the same time?
How do I bulk print admit cards for an entire class?
Which types of student certificates can be printed in bulk?
What is the process for bulk printing student documents?
